identity: Haute Couture::Le Noir Brand Manager Don Quixote
frame_numbering: Zero-based source decoded frames; intervals are [start,end). Seconds = frame*1001/30000.
measurement_policy: Body height H excludes antlers, hammer, hair trails and VFX; dimensions/distances are screen-space estimates, usually ±0.5 H or ±25%, not world-space measurements. Palette hex values are visual approximations, not original asset colors.
mapping_policy: No skill labels or coin UI in this trailer. Named mappings are hypotheses from the supplied kit, counts and motifs. The supplied kit itself warns of paraphrase risk. Distinguish visible contact events from inferred game coins; do not force equality.
timing_policy: Every gameplay source frame 315–1960 inspected in native-rate sheets. Overviews cover the entire file at 6 fps. Frame-accurate refers to visible pose/effect/cut onset; exact physical contact can be occluded and is bracketed where necessary.
mapping_evidence: Two separated hammer-contact flashes fit two Blunt coins.
No nail summon in this occurrence; extra Witness Ye in Silence also has two Blunt coins, so count alone cannot uniquely distinguish them.

weapon.parts: Two heavy faceted cylindrical/drum striking heads joined by a narrow central collar; long thin shaft with banded, capped butt. Rectangular inset/rib outlines on the drums. Not three separate floating blocks.
weapon.held: One hand is clearly visible on the long shaft in poses/cut-ins; carried across/behind shoulder, then extended in the swing. Some motion frames obscure the other hand; a continuous two-hand grip cannot be established.

evidence.observation: Hammer head next to enemy, continuous thin haft back to Don.
One gloved hand grips shaft across shoulder; capped butt above right.
Both drums and center collar visible behind shoulder.
One visible hand low on shaft during final strike.

props.description: No detached damaging object. Broad gold curves follow the hammer; the shaft and capped butt do not establish a second spear.

caster_motion.label: approach_dash
caster_motion.description: Low forward dash, about 2–3 H relative to target; camera tracks, so raw screen displacement is misleading.

caster_motion.label: windup_dash
caster_motion.description: Crouches with hammer behind shoulder, advances about 1–2 H, violet afterimage left behind.

caster_motion.label: swing
caster_motion.description: Sweeps hammer at target, feet stay on same ground plane; about 1 H center separation.

caster_motion.label: pass_through_and_recovery
caster_motion.description: Travels through target to its right by about 2 H; stays in low extended dash pose, not lying prone. Cut resets positions.

hits.contact: Hammer head/sweep at target; white impact star occludes exact head contact.
hits.timing_basis: First visible target-impact/occluding flash frame; not a game-engine damage timestamp.

evidence.observation: First gold crescent and target star at 12.445767; no additional strike at 12.67.

hits.contact: Hammer-driven dash through target, large horizontal contact flash.
hits.timing_basis: First visible target-impact/occluding flash frame; not a game-engine damage timestamp.

evidence.observation: Full impact flash follows preparatory spin at frames 399–400.

beats.label: coin_1
beats.description: Contact star, upper-to-low crescent wraps around; one continuous hit effect.

beats.label: reload
beats.description: Hammer rises behind shoulder; old ring/shards decay.

beats.label: finisher_windup
beats.description: Gold bands gather around advancing body; not target impact yet.

beats.label: coin_2_flash
beats.description: White/gold flash and large horizontal speed streaks; camera close.

beats.label: recovery
beats.description: Camera releases, Don passes right; triangles disperse.

effects.name: dash ghost
effects.shape: translucent body silhouette and horizontal haze
effects.motion_and_fade: Violet ghost remains as live sprite moves right.

effects.name: first hammer sweep
effects.shape: nearly closed C-shaped thick ribbon with sharp star at right
effects.position: around caster to target; front lower arc crosses sprites
effects.motion_and_fade: Bright cream core, gold rim, dark translucent inner crescent; opens and drops toward floor, then thins.

effects.name: reset traces
effects.shape: low broken ring, violet haze, triangular shards
effects.motion_and_fade: Residual ring fades while new shoulder windup begins.

effects.name: finisher flash
effects.shape: white star and horizontal gold-white streaks
effects.motion_and_fade: Saturated white first frame; held brightness through close-up then shrinks.

effects.name: finisher debris
effects.shape: long horizontal streaks, curved upper ribbon, gold and black triangles
effects.motion_and_fade: Streaks retract; flecks spread and fade before cut.

camera.framing: Don left, enemy right; body occupies about 25% picture height.
Pan right into charging Don; enemy briefly cropped.
Don centered-left; impact cropped on right.
Pull out to show C arc and both bodies.
Reset framing, then slight pullback before dash.
Hair and speed bands fill central frame.
Enemy now left of Don; no camera reversal, Don crossed it.

ambient_effects.name: arena ambience
ambient_effects.shape: cyan drifting points and small hollow bubbles
ambient_effects.position: throughout arena in front of and behind sprites
ambient_effects.motion_and_fade: Slow drifting; persistent and independent of skill.

ambient_effects.name: persistent angular field
ambient_effects.shape: thin zigzag/stepped gold polylines, with longer verticals late
ambient_effects.position: background behind actors; later floor plane too
ambient_effects.motion_and_fade: Grows after the self-centered activation; remains between attacks. Not a projectile or repeated damage.

limitations: Skill name is inferred, not read from UI. See mapping confidence and alternatives.
Exact game damage processing and coin resolution are not visible. Contact flash frame may precede/occlude physical overlap.
